Import.Start: JJK 5e: importing {n} compendiums… this can take a minute.
Import.Done: JJK 5e: import finished. Open the Compendium tab → "JJK 5e V.6".
Import.ConfirmNew:
Import the Jujutsu Kaisen 5e (V.6) content into world compendiums?

Classes, Innate Techniques, Races, Feats, Backgrounds, Equipment, Macros, Roll Tables and the full rules journal.
Import.ConfirmUpdate: Re-import all JJK 5e V.6 compendiums? Their current contents will be replaced. Items already on actors are not touched.
Import.ModulePacks: JJK 5e: compendiums are now built into the module (Compendium tab → "JJK 5e V.6"). No import needed.
Import.RemoveOld:
The JJK 5e compendiums now ship inside the module. This world still has {n} old imported copies.

Characters were re-linked to the new compendiums. Delete the old copies?

CE.Name: Cursed Energy
CE.ShortRestPrompt: Hit Dice to spend for CE (max {cap}). Mark the Hit Dice as spent on the sheet.
CE.AbilityPrompt: Cursed Energy ability for {name}. It sets the CE pool, the CE save DC (8 + PB + mod) and CE attack rolls (via the sheet's spellcasting ability).

Technique.Title: Choose Innate Technique
Technique.Current: Current: {name}. Changing it does not delete old features.

BlackFlash.Success: Critical damage uses 3× dice and ignores resistances. You enter (or stack) The Zone.
BlackFlash.Damage: critical dice tripled. Remember: this damage ignores resistances.

Zone.Name: The Zone
Zone.Description: The Zone (1 minute): advantage on attack rolls, +1 critical range and +1 Black Flash range per stack, recover Technique Burnout and RCT pool, lower Reduced Output by 1.

Domain.SureHitAttack: this technique attack counts as a hit against targets you choose inside your domain.
Domain.SureHitSave: targets you choose inside your domain automatically fail this saving throw.
Domain.Description: Domain open (1 minute). When it ends (or you delete this effect), Technique Burnout is applied automatically.
Domain.OutsideHint: Creatures outside take {n}d6 bludgeoning and are pushed to the edge (apply manually).
Domain.ClashWon: {name} wins the domain clash: sure hit restored.
Domain.WeakMissed: {name} can't find the weak spot (Perception {total} vs DC 30).
Domain.ClashEqual: Equal refinement: the domains cancel out. At 1/3 HP each caster rolls a flat DC 15 or loses the domain.
Domain.ClashResult: {win} overpowers {lose} (+{diff} refinement): {lose}'s domain breaks in {rounds} rounds, shrinking 15 ft per round.
Domain.ClashNoSureHit: Sure hit is negated for both domains during the clash.
Domain.ClashShrink: {name}'s domain shrinks to {r} ft ({rounds} rounds left).
Domain.EqualCheck: Domain clash: keep the domain (DC 15, no modifiers)
Domain.BarrierlessPrompt: Expand without a barrier? No time limit, 655 ft radius; the domain only breaks if you take 1/3 of your maximum HP in one hit and fail a CON save (DC 15 + half the damage).
Domain.BarrierlessDescription: Barrierless Domain: no barrier, no time limit, 655 ft radius. Taking 1/3 of your max HP in one instance forces a CON save (DC 15 + half the damage) or the domain is destroyed.
Domain.BarrierlessStats: No barrier · radius {radius} ft · no time limit
Domain.IncompleteDescription: Incomplete Domain: 100 ft, 1 minute, refinement 0, no barrier and no sure hit. Advantage on technique attack rolls; creatures inside have disadvantage on saves against your Innate Technique. Effects are halved.
Domain.IncompleteStats: Incomplete Domain · {radius} ft · no barrier, no sure hit

Burnout.Name: Technique Burnout
Burnout.Description: After a Domain Expansion: no Innate Technique features and 2 levels of exhaustion for 1 minute or until you land a Black Flash.
Burnout.RecoveryUnavailable: Burnout Recovery needs Technique Burnout, Reverse Cursed Technique and 750+ domain refinement.
Burnout.RecoverySuccess: {name} rebuilds their brain: Technique Burnout ends.
Burnout.RecoveryFail: Burnout Recovery failed: 8d6 psychic damage, no actions or bonus actions until the start of your next turn.

Output.Title: Output
Output.MaxPrompt: Base CE cost of the technique you amplify (minimum 5, or 3 for a shikigami summon):
Output.TooLow: Maximum Output needs a base cost of at least 5 CE (3 for shikigami).
Output.ShikigamiOnly: A base cost under 5 only works for shikigami summoning techniques.
Output.Check: Cursed Energy check vs Reduced Output (DC {dc})
Output.Benefits: Choose one: range +50%, one damage roll +50% dice, attack bonus +50% (DC + half PB), duration +50%, or another value +50%. Shikigami: size +1 with an extra necrotic die, HP +50%, or attack + half PB.
Output.ReducedDescription: Lowers the CE range of techniques by the Output penalty. A technique whose base cost exceeds the Max cannot be used (enforced by the module). Not using CE for 1 minute or landing a Black Flash removes 1 level.

Soul.Name: Soul Damage
Soul.Description: Soul Damage: maximum HP −{total} until a long rest. Reverse Cursed Technique and regeneration cannot restore it.
Soul.DescriptionLasting: Soul Damage: maximum HP −{total}. Reverse Cursed Technique and regeneration cannot restore it; the GM removes it.

rleg.broken: Movement is halved and you can't jump.
rleg.lost: You lose your right leg. Movement is halved.

lleg.broken: Movement is halved and you can't jump.
lleg.lost: You lose your left leg. Movement is halved.

rarm.broken: Skill checks and attack rolls using this arm have disadvantage.
rarm.lost: Skill checks and attack rolls with this arm are impossible.

larm.broken: Skill checks and attack rolls using this arm have disadvantage.
larm.lost: Skill checks and attack rolls with this arm are impossible.

torso.lost: The target dies unless it can live without a torso.

head.lost: The target dies unless it can live without a head.

Summon.Title: Summons
Summon.Dismiss: Dismiss all my summons in this scene
Summon.NotFound: JJK 5e: no actor named "{name}" in the world or compendiums.
Summon.Hint: Searches your actors (folder "JJK Shikigami") and then the compendiums (SRD). Tokens appear next to yours; the GM must be online.

Panel.NoPool: No Cursed Energy pool yet: add a JJK class.

Notify.NoActor: JJK 5e: select a token or assign a character first.
Notify.NotOwner: JJK 5e: you do not own that actor.
Notify.HRNoTechnique: JJK 5e: Heavenly Restriction has no Innate Technique.
Notify.NoPool: {name} has no Cursed Energy pool feature.
Notify.NoPoolNotSpent: JJK 5e: {name} has no Cursed Energy pool, CE was not spent.
Notify.NotEnoughCE: JJK 5e: not enough Cursed Energy ({value} / {cost} needed).
Notify.Burnout: JJK 5e: Technique Burnout — you cannot use Innate Technique features right now.
Notify.ROMax: JJK 5e: Reduced Output {level} — base cost {cost} CE exceeds the max of {max}.
Notify.NoTechPack: JJK 5e: Innate Techniques compendium not found. Import the content first.
Notify.TechniqueSet: JJK 5e: {name} technique set to {technique} (no new features for this level).
Notify.NoGM: JJK 5e: a GM must be connected to summon or dismiss tokens.
Notify.NeedDnd5e: JJK 5e V.6 requires the D&D 5e system.
Notify.NoInspiration: JJK 5e: {name} has no inspiration to use this mindset.
Notify.GMOnly: Only the GM can do that.
Notify.GMDeclined: The GM declined or did not answer the request.

autoSpendCE.Name: Automatic Cursed Energy spending
autoSpendCE.Hint: Features with a fixed CE cost spend it from the Cursed Energy pool and are blocked if there is not enough CE. Scaled costs use the scaling field.

ceChat.Name: Cursed Energy chat messages
ceChat.Hint: Post a short chat line every time CE is spent or regained.

ceResource.Name: Cursed Energy resource slot
ceResource.Hint: Mirror the CE pool in this actor resource so it can be shown as a token bar and edited there.

autoTokenBar.Name: Show CE as token bar
autoTokenBar.Hint: If a token has no second bar, use it for Cursed Energy.

blackFlash.Name: Automatic Black Flash checks
blackFlash.Hint: On a melee critical hit by a player character (not Heavenly Restriction) roll a d20 for Black Flash and apply / stack The Zone.

blackFlashDamage.Name: Black Flash triple damage
blackFlashDamage.Hint: After a Black Flash the next critical damage roll uses 3× dice instead of 2×.

zoneAdvantage.Name: The Zone grants advantage
zoneAdvantage.Hint: While in The Zone attack rolls are made with advantage.

domainTracking.Name: Domain Expansion tracking
domainTracking.Hint: Expanding a domain adds a 1-minute effect; when it ends Technique Burnout is applied (2 exhaustion, techniques blocked).

domainSureHit.Name: Domain sure-hit reminders
domainSureHit.Hint: While your domain is open, technique attacks and saves post a sure-hit reminder in the chat.

autoExpire.Name: Expire JJK effects
autoExpire.Hint: Delete The Zone, Domain and Technique Burnout when their duration ends (skipped if the Times Up module is active).

headerButton.Name: JJK button on character sheets
headerButton.Hint: Show a JJK button in the header of character sheets to open the JJK panel.

importMenu.Name: Re-import JJK 5e content
importMenu.Label: Import / Update compendiums
importMenu.Hint: Rebuild the JJK 5e V.6 world compendiums from the module data.

modifierReminders.Name: Feat modifier reminders
modifierReminders.Hint: When you use a technique feature, list in the chat the feats you own that modify it.

checkPrereqs.Name: Check feat prerequisites
checkPrereqs.Hint: Warn when a feat or feature is added to an actor that does not meet its prerequisites (features, CE score, level, skill).

pointBuyBudget.Name: Point buy: points
pointBuyBudget.Hint: Points available for the point buy (default 27).

pointBuyMin.Name: Point buy: minimum score
pointBuyMin.Hint: Starting and minimum score for each ability (default 10).

pointBuyMax.Name: Point buy: maximum score
pointBuyMax.Hint: Highest score you can buy before race, background or class bonuses (default 18).

pointBuyDoubleFrom.Name: Point buy: double cost from
pointBuyDoubleFrom.Hint: Scores at or above this value cost 2 points each (default 14).

asiFeatPicker.Name: JJK feats in Ability Score Improvement
asiFeatPicker.Hint: Adds a list of the JJK feats you qualify for to every Ability Score Improvement step when you level up.

animations.Name: Animations (Sequencer + JB2A)
animations.Hint: Plays animations for JJK attacks, techniques, healing and domains when Sequencer and JB2A are active. Items you configured in Automated Animations keep their own animation.

animOverrides.Name: Animation overrides (JSON)
animOverrides.Hint: Optional JSON mapping animation keys to Sequencer database paths or files, e.g. {"melee": "jb2a.unarmed_strike.physical.02.blue", "domain": "jb2a.darkness.green"}.

sceneTools.Name: JJK buttons in the token toolbar
sceneTools.Hint: Shows one JJK button in the left Token controls toolbar that opens a compact menu with all JJK macros.

levelUpButton.Name: Level-up button on full XP bar
levelUpButton.Hint: Shows a Level up button under the XP bar when the character has enough experience. It opens the normal level-up dialog.

enableSummoning.Name: Enable shikigami summoning
enableSummoning.Hint: Turns on the system's Allow Summoning setting so Ten Shadows features place their shikigami tokens. Players without token permission get them placed by the GM automatically.

pointBuyCosts.Name: Point buy: cost table
pointBuyCosts.Hint: Total cost of each score, as score:cost pairs (default 10:0, 11:1, 12:2, 13:3, 14:5, 15:7, 16:10, 17:13, 18:17).

dataLanguage.Name: Compendium language
dataLanguage.Hint: Language of the imported compendium items and folders. The rules journals always include both the English original and the Spanish manual. Changing it asks to re-import.

sheetStrip.Name: JJK bar on the character sheet
sheetStrip.Hint: CE with +/−, grade, vows and quick buttons at the top of the sheet.

turnSummary.Name: Turn summary
turnSummary.Hint: At the start of your turn, whisper your CE, active vows and active forms.

autoHotbar.Name: Automatic JJK hotbar
autoHotbar.Hint: Refill the JJK hotbar page whenever a JJK item is added to your character.

hotbarPage.Name: JJK hotbar page
hotbarPage.Hint: Hotbar page (1–5) used for technique and CE abilities.

diceColors.Name: JJK dice colors (Dice So Nice)
diceColors.Hint: Purple dice for techniques, gold in a domain, black and red on a Black Flash.

domainZones.Name: Domain zone and barrier
domainZones.Hint: Draw the domain on the map, track barrier HP/AC, clashes and sure hit only inside.

tmfxAuras.Name: Token Magic FX auras
tmfxAuras.Hint: With Token Magic FX: a red glow on tokens in the Zone (after a Black Flash) and a purple glow while their domain is open.

fxDomains.Name: FXMaster domain tint
fxDomains.Hint: With FXMaster: tint the scene purple while a domain expansion is open.

strictPrereqs.Name: Enforce prerequisite checks for players
strictPrereqs.Hint: When enabled, a player cannot add a feat that fails the JJK requirement checks. GMs can still grant exceptions.

playerGMRequests.Name: Allow player requests for GM operations (manual approval)
playerGMRequests.Hint: Disabled by default. If enabled, requests still require active-GM confirmation; client-reported identity is not authenticated.

updateMenu.Name: Update items on actors
updateMenu.Label: Update automation
updateMenu.Hint: Replace the automation of JJK items already on actors with the current compendium version (keeps per-character state).

PointBuy.Title: Point Buy
PointBuy.Hint: Every score starts at {min}. Budget: {budget}/{budget} points, maximum {max} before other bonuses. Cost of each score:
PointBuy.Order: Use this before adding your race, class or background so their ability bonuses are added on top.
PointBuy.Over: You spent {spent} points; the limit is {budget}.

ASI.Hint: {n} JJK feats meet your prerequisites. Choose one instead of the ability score increase.
ASI.ChooseHint: Choose one: improve your ability scores, or take a feat instead.

LevelUp.Title: Level up
LevelUp.NoClass: This character has no class yet.

Vow.Title: Binding Vows
Vow.Name: Name
Vow.MechanicsHint: Optional. Positive numbers for benefits, negative for restrictions. They become an Active Effect.
Vow.LockWeek: The GM unlocks it (1 work week)
Vow.EndsNever: When you suspend or break it
Vow.OverLimit: {n} active vows exceed your limit ({max} = proficiency bonus). Allowed, but tell your GM.
Vow.PartnerManual: {name} must record the vow on their own sheet (you don't own that character).
Vow.Locked: This vow can't be suspended yet.
Vow.BreakConfirm: Break {name}? You lose its benefits and may suffer the punishment.
Vow.LostBenefits: All benefits of the vow are lost.
Vow.PersonalBreak: Personal vow: the GM decides any further consequence.
Vow.PunishmentHint: Choose: 5 levels of exhaustion for 10 days, or roll on the misfortune table.
Vow.DeleteConfirm: Delete this vow from the list (without in-game consequences)?

Career.Title: Sorcerer Career
Career.StepTrials: Pass 3 missions with a Grade 1 sorcerer ({n}/3)
Career.RecRule: Teachers can't recommend their own students.
Career.RecHint: Name of the Grade 1 sorcerer who recommends:

Hotbar.Filled: {n} JJK abilities placed on hotbar page {page}.
Hotbar.NoPermission: Couldn't create macros. Ask the GM for the 'Create script macros' permission.

Curse.Place: Place a hidden token in view

Keys.HudHint: JJK: click = panel · right click = −1 CE · Shift + right click = +1 CE

Breakthrough.Name: Breakthroughs
Breakthrough.RCTYes: Reverse Cursed Technique awakened! Add the RCT feature.

Create.Title: JJK 5e: create a character

Step.abilities: Step 1 — Ability scores. Set your scores with point buy.
Step.class: Step 2 — Class. Pick a class; its level 1 choices include your Innate Technique.
Step.technique: Step 3 — Innate Technique. Confirm the technique of your character.
Step.race: Step 4 — Race. Pick a race and spend its ability bonuses.
Step.background: Step 5 — Background. Pick a background; technique feats only show those of your technique.

Create.Stopped: Character creation paused. Click Create character on the sheet to continue.
Create.OnlyTechnique: Only the {n} feats of your Innate Technique are shown.
Create.NoTechniqueYet: Choose your Innate Technique first (class level 1): technique feats are hidden until then.

Shikigami.Title: Customize a shikigami
Shikigami.Hint: Creates your own copy of the creature (you can edit its stats, name and token). Your technique will summon your copy. ✎ = already yours: opens its sheet.
Shikigami.Created: {name} created: edit it freely, your summons now use it.
Shikigami.None: This character has no summon abilities.

Update.Title: Update JJK automation
Update.None: {name}: JJK automation is up to date.
Update.NoneWorld: All JJK items on actors are up to date.
Update.Prompt: {n} JJK item(s) on {name} have newer automation in the compendium:
Update.PromptWorld: {n} actor(s) have JJK items with newer automation:
Update.Keeps: Kept: uses spent, quantity, equipped/attuned, advancement choices, personal shikigami and your CE ability. Replaced: activities, effects, description and JJK flags.
Update.Notice: JJK 5e {version}: {n} actor(s) have items with outdated automation.

Builder.Title: Original Technique Builder
Builder.Intro: Build your own innate technique following the manual's guidelines: 1st Lapse, 3rd Lapse or Extension, 6th Extension, 11th Maximum, 18th Domain Expansion. Leave a feature name empty to skip it. The items are created in the Items directory (folder “JJK: Custom Techniques”) and can then be chosen like any technique.
Builder.Name: Technique name
Builder.EarlyDomain: Domain Expansion at 3rd level (weaker sure-hit, as Deadly Sentencing or Pachinko Fever)
Builder.Created: {name}: {n} technique feature(s) created in the Items directory.
Builder.NoPermission: You need permission to create items (ask the GM).
